description: An animated, reactive illustrated scene: a character in weather the reader can turn up, or acting out the story's beat — so a magnitude or a turn is felt, not just read. Version 1 renders rain with the robot, and the cheat beat with the robot.

action.description: The narrative beat the character acts out. Version 1 renders cheat only: the robot outmaneuvers the board by resigning before they can oust him — the reader scrubs the beat from the board meeting to the empty chair. Leave it out for a weather-only scene. A scene uses an action or an effect, not both.

character.description: Which character stands in the scene. Version 1 renders the robot only.

effect.description: Which weather the scene plays with. Version 1 renders rain only; further effects arrive as data, not a rewrite. Leave it out for an action-only scene. A scene uses an effect or an action, not both.

heavy_from.description: Fraction of the maximum at which the heavy rain layer starts fading in. A design choice, not a fact from the article, so the checker does not verify it.

label.description: What the scene is about, in a few words: "Rainfall in 36 hours" or "He resigned before they could oust him". Any number in it must appear in the article.

max_value.description: The article number the scale tops out at, a whole number: the rainfall in millimetres. Required when the scene has a scale (effect scenes); leave it out for action-only scenes.

medium_from.description: Fraction of the maximum at which the medium rain layer starts fading in. A design choice, not a fact from the article, so the checker does not verify it.

start_fraction.description: Where the slider starts, as a fraction of the maximum. A design choice, not a fact from the article, so the checker does not verify it.

unit.description: The unit shown with the value: " mm". Required when max_value is present.

unit_after.description: True when the unit goes after the number ("210 mm"), false when it goes before ("$210").

title: Scene
